queries:
WITH station_usage AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  AVG(station_avg) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
  SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count,
  1.0 * SUM(telescope_count) / SUM(SUM(telescope_count)) OVER () AS overall_share
FROM station_usage
GROUP BY lunarstage

WITH station_usage AS (
    SELECT
        o.observstation,
        o.lunarstage,
        AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
    FROM observatories AS o
    JOIN telescopes AS t
      ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
)
SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct,
    COUNT(*) AS observatory_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS overall_share
FROM station_usage
GROUP BY lunarstage

WITH station_usage AS (
  SELECT
    o.observstation,
    o.lunarstage,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg,
    COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
),
phase_usage AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(station_avg) AS average_bandwidth_usage,
    SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count
  FROM station_usage
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  lunarstage,
  average_bandwidth_usage,
  telescope_count,
  1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
FROM phase_usage

WITH station_usage AS (
    SELECT
        o.observstation,
        o.lunarstage,
        AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage
    FROM observatories AS o
    JOIN telescopes AS t
      ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage
    HAVING COUNT(t.bandusagepct) > 0
)
SELECT
    lunarstage,
    AVG(avg_bandwidth_usage) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
    COUNT(*) AS observatory_count,
    COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS overall_share
FROM station_usage
GROUP BY lunarstage;
